item.title: Jenkins & CI/CD Interview Questions
item.description:
Beginner (Basics & Definitions)

  1. Explain Jenkins?
  2. What is the purpose of Jenkins?
  3. What is the use of Jenkins in automation?
  4. What is CI/CD?
  5. Explain CI and CD?
  6. What is a CI/CD pipeline?
  7. What is the difference between CI and CD?
  8. As a tester, how do you use Jenkins?
  9. Have you integrated Jenkins in your project?

Intermediate (Configuration & Usage)

  1. How to create a build in Jenkins?
  2. How do you configure Jenkins for a project?
  3. In Jenkins, where do you set the periodic time?
  4. Where do you find the console output in Jenkins?
  5. How do you trigger a Jenkins job from GitHub?
  6. How do you configure a CI/CD pipeline for execution?
  7. Explain the use of Jenkins in an Automation Framework?
  8. How do you run your automation scripts through Jenkins?
  9. How do you handle parameters in Jenkins?

Advanced (Scenarios & Troubleshooting)

  1. Does configuring Jenkins mean it is 100% CI/CD? Explain?
  2. Scenario: Code is correct locally but fails via Jenkins. What are the possible causes?
  3. How long does it take to run your regression suite in Jenkins?
  4. If the 4th script fails, will the subsequent scripts run?
  5. How do you generate and share reports from Jenkins?
  6. Explain the integration of CI/CD with Git and cloud tools?
  7. Explain the end-to-end flow from code commit to deployment?

Questions with Answers

Beginner (Basics & Definitions) - Answers

1. Explain Jenkins?

Answer: Jenkins is an open-source automation server that helps automate the parts of software development related to building, testing, and deploying, facilitating Continuous Integration (CI).
